name: Deva Cassel
bio:
Deva Cassel is an Italian-French model and actress, born on September 12, 2004, in Rome, Italy. She is the daughter of Monica Bellucci and Vincent Cassel, two renowned actors.

Cassel began her career in modeling, working with brands like Dolce & Gabbana, Cartier, and Dior. She has appeared in fragrance campaigns and fashion shows, gaining recognition for her striking looks and presence in the industry.

In 2023, she made her acting debut in the Italian drama The Beautiful Summer, and she appear in the Netflix series The Leopard (2025) as Angelica Sedara.
